source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical footer size used min-width. Current .footer-button uses min-inline-size, and nearby layout uses margin-block and margin-inline properties. Follow those current forms for new footer dimensions and margins so the property names describe the inline and block axes. This is a scoped accepted style pattern; no visual check of right-to-left layout ran.
title: Keep footer sizing in logical CSS properties in current Account Hub code
